options.name: name
options.description: The GitHub user/organization repository to tap.

options.name: path
options.description: A V(:) separated list of paths to search for C(brew) executable.

options.name: url
options.description: The optional git URL of the repository to tap. The URL is not assumed to be on GitHub, and the protocol does not have to be HTTP. Any location and protocol that git can handle is fine. O(name) option may not be a list of multiple taps (but a single tap instead) when this option is provided.
